body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Original) A method of determining a repair method for a defect in a bladed rotor, the method comprising:comparing the defect in a three-dimensional model of an inspected integrally bladed rotor (IBR) to a plurality of known defects from a repair database;
determining the defect is matching a known defect in the plurality of known defects in the repair database; and
generating a repair process associated with the known defect in response to determining the defect is matching the known defect.
2. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the defect is matching the known defect in response to having between 90% and 100 % similarity to a defect shape and a defect size based on a tolerance threshold.
3. (Original) The method of claim 2, wherein the defect is further matching the known defect in response to being in a location that is a same location as the known defect.
4. (Original) The method of claim 3, wherein the location and the same location are one of a leading edge, a trailing edge, a tip, and a transition from an airfoil to a platform.
5. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising performing the repair process associated with the repaired defect on the defect of the inspected IBR.
6. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the repair process further comprises generating instructions to be performed by a computer numerical control (CNC) machine.
7. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the repair process further comprises generating instructions directly an additive manufacturing machine.
8. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising:
comparing a second defect in the three-dimensional model to the plurality of known defects in the repair database;
determining, the second defect does not match any of the plurality of known defects; and generating a second repair process associated with a second repaired defect shape based on a structural analysis and an aerodynamic analysis of the three-dimensional model of the inspected IBR with a first repaired defect shape of the defect associated with the repair process for the known defect and the second repaired defect shape.
9. (Original) The method of claim 8, further comprising iterating the second repaired defect shape until a structural criteria for the structural analysis and an aerodynamic criteria for the aerodynamic analysis are met.
10. (Original) The method of claim 8, further comprising scaling a structural results from the structural analysis based on test engine test data for a tested IBR associated with the inspected IBR.
11. (Withdrawn) A method of determining a repair method for a defect in a bladed rotor, the method comprising:determining a potential repair process for the defect of an inspected integrally bladed rotor (IBR);
generating a finite element model and an aerodynamic model for the inspected IBR with a potential repair based on one of a point cloud for the inspected IBR and a three dimensional model for the inspected IBR;
performing a structural simulation of the finite element model for the inspected IBR with the potential repair based on boundary conditions of the inspected IBR in a gas turbine engine during operation;
performing an aerodynamic simulation of the aerodynamic model for the inspected IBR with the potential repair based on the boundary conditions of the inspected IBR in the gas turbine engine during operation;
determining whether the inspected IBR with the potential repair meets structural and aerodynamic criteria; and
generating the potential repair process for the defect in response to determining the inspected IBR with the potential repair meets structural and the aerodynamic criteria.
12. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 11, wherein the structural simulation and the aerodynamic simulation are performed in parallel.
13. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 11, further comprising scaling structural results from the structural simulation based on an engine test data.
14. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 13, wherein the aerodynamic simulation is based on engine operating conditions.
15. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 11, wherein determining the potential repair results in a repaired IBR that is outside of tolerances from a product definition for the inspected IBR.
16. (Withdrawn) The method of claim 11, further comprising determining a second potential repair process with a second potential repair in response to the inspected IBR with the potential repair not meeting one of a structural criteria and the aerodynamic criteria.
17. (Withdrawn) An article of manufacture including a tangible, non-transitory computer- readable storage medium having instructions stored thereon that, in response to execution by a processor, cause the processor to perform operations comprising:receiving, via the processor, one of a point cloud and a three-dimensional model for an inspected integrally bladed rotor (IBR) and a defect including a defect shape, a defect size, and a defect location;
selecting, via the processor, a plurality of inspected IBRs to form a stack of IBRs of a rotor module of a gas turbine engine based on the defect;
performing, via the processor, a simulation of the rotor module in the gas turbine engine, the rotor module including the inspected IBR with a potential repaired defect;
determining, via the processor, whether the rotor module meets an aerodynamic performance criteria and a structural criteria; and
generating a repair process for the defect in response to the rotor module meeting the aerodynamic performance criteria and the structural criteria.
18. (Withdrawn) The article of manufacture of claim 17, wherein the potential repaired defect is outside of tolerances from a product definition for the inspected IBR.
19. (Withdrawn) The article of manufacture of claim 17, wherein the operations further comprise receiving a unique identifier for the inspected IBR; and determining, via the processor, a location of the inspected IBR in the stack of IBRs based on the unique identifier.
20. (Withdrawn) The article of manufacture of claim 17, wherein the operations further comprise generating a unique identifier for each inspected IBR in the stack of IBRs in response to determining the rotor module meets the aerodynamic performance criteria and the structural criteria.
